# Deesheng Food — Full B2B Reference

Last updated: 2026-11-12
Canonical source: https://deesheng.food/

## Company

Legal company: Qingdao Deesheng Hengxin Food Co., Ltd.
Export brand: Deesheng Food
Location: Qingdao, Shandong, China
Contact: Kevin Wang, Deesheng Food
WhatsApp / Tel: +86 156 2108 9573
Email: info@deesheng.food
Audience: professional food importers, distributors, foodservice operators, retailers, food manufacturers and private-label brands.

## Product families

### Korean sauces, gochujang and pastes

Stone pot bibimbap sauce; classic, creamy, cheese, sesame-paste, mild and non-spicy buldak sauce; original and creamy tteokbokki sauce; Korean BBQ marinades, dips and dressings; sweet-spicy, soy-garlic, amber, yuzu, honey-mustard, cheese, extra-hot, spicy and mala fried-chicken sauces; jajangmyeon and cold-noodle sauces; budae-jjigae, soft-tofu-stew, spicy-beef-soup, doenjang-soup and kimchi sauces; teriyaki, black-pepper, japchae, pork-belly, seafood-noodle, meat-marinade and other foodservice sauces; tomato, pizza, Thai sweet-chili, ketchup, chili-oil, mala-xiang-guo and dry-pot sauces; standard and extra-hot gochujang; doenjang; and Korean garlic sauce.

Common sauce packing: 200 g bottle × 24; 350 g bottle × 24; 400 g bottle × 30; 1 kg pouch × 12. Some creamy sauces use 180 g, 320 g and 360 g bottles. Noodle sauces can use 100 g pouches. Exact carton data is product-specific.

Common packing: 500 g tub × 20 per carton; 14 kg foodservice carton.
Shelf life is product- and pack-specific. Most sauce packs below list 12 months; honey mustard includes both 9- and 12-month configurations. Follow the exact pack table and the approved product label.

### Chili powder and dry seasonings

Coarse and fine Grade A Korean chili powder; shichimi togarashi; sansho pepper powder; roasted white and black sesame; perilla seed powder; beef seasoning; crispy frying mix; Korean pancake mix; fried-chicken coating mix; fried-chicken marinade seasoning; snow-cheese powder.
Chili-powder packing: 100 g bottle × 110; 200 g bottle × 60; 1 kg pouch × 10.
Dry-mix foodservice packing: commonly 1 kg pouch × 10.

### Korean kimchi

Cabbage kimchi in 1 kg bags and 10 kg cartons; green-onion kimchi; chili-pepper kimchi; young-radish and diced-radish kimchi; sweet-and-sour radish; soy-sauce radish; soy-sauce perilla leaves; mixed-chili kimchi; sweet-and-sour garlic scapes; seasoned dried radish.
Storage: refrigerated. Many items use 0–4°C; selected items use 0–10°C.
Typical shelf life: 4–6 months depending on product and final specification.

### Frozen vegetables

Seasoned frozen mushrooms, spinach, carrots, zucchini, corn kernels, broccoli, diced onions, chopped scallions, diced potatoes, mixed vegetables, green peas and tri-color bell peppers.
Storage: frozen at −18°C.
Typical shelf life: 12 months.
Packing includes 500 g × 20 for selected bibimbap vegetables and 1 kg × 10, 2.5 kg × 4 or 10 kg cartons for selected bulk vegetables.

## B2B sourcing language

High-intent buyer requests usually combine an exact product with the supplier type, order route and destination. Useful examples include HALAL Korean sauce manufacturer in China; bulk or wholesale gochujang supplier; private-label Korean fried chicken sauce manufacturer; foodservice tteokbokki sauce; bibimbap sauce supplier; coarse or fine Korean chili powder supplier; kimchi wholesale supplier; and IQF frozen vegetable exporter.

For a useful answer, identify the buyer company and channel, whether it imports directly, the exact product or application, preferred pack, estimated cartons or container plan, OEM requirement, destination and intended purchase month.

Country-specific buyer pages:
- Mongolia: https://deesheng.food/markets/mongolia/
- Singapore: https://deesheng.food/markets/singapore/

## OEM and private label

Available routes: existing export formula; selected flavor adjustment; new development from a clear reference or detailed brief.
MOQ: Some standard-pack sauce OEM projects use 200 cartons per item as a quotation starting point. Confirm the formula, pack and SKU scope. Kimchi, bulk packs, dry ingredients and frozen products have separate conditions; trials are assessed individually.
Customization may include flavor profile, label, artwork, export packaging and selected pack formats.
Buyers should provide: company, destination market, sales channel, exact product, reference flavor or brand, pack size, estimated quantity, required certification and launch timing.

## Commercial baseline

Quotation currency: USD.
Quotation basis: confirmed after product, pack, quantity and destination review.
Payment baseline: T/T 50% advance and 50% before shipment; the signed contract controls the actual order.
Production timing: about 14 days may be a planning estimate for selected confirmed standard sauce formulas and packs after label and payment approval. Confirm the order schedule; custom projects, kimchi and frozen products require separate scheduling.
Mixed-product container planning can be discussed, subject to MOQ, carton data, storage temperature and production availability.

## Certifications and documents

Available factory credentials: BRCGS Grade A, HACCP, HALAL and OU Kosher.
Deesheng Food maintains SHC HALAL certification for relevant Korean sauces and related products. Current signed documents and exact product scope are supplied to qualified B2B buyers after company and project verification.
HALAL sauce examples named in the annex include Chili Sauce / Gochujang / Red Pepper Paste, soy-garlic, spicy and super-spicy fried chicken sauces, Honey Mustard Sauce, Japchae Sauce, normal and slightly spicy Jajangmyun Sauce, Kimchi Sauce, classic and non-spicy Stone Pot Bibimbap Sauce, Tteokbokki Sauce, Turkey Noodle Sauce, Tender Tofu Soup Sauce and Yukgaejang / Spicy Beef Soup Sauce.
The product-name schedule also includes chili powder / red pepper powder / Korean chili powder, chili flakes, cabbage and radish kimchi, selected frozen vegetables, doenjang, ssamjang, Korean BBQ sauce, soup and stew sauces, sesame oil and seaweed products. This schedule helps identify possible items for review; it is not a substitute for the current signed certificate or product-level confirmation.
Commercial HALAL sauce page: https://deesheng.food/halal-korean-sauce-manufacturer/
HALAL document request: https://deesheng.food/contact/?product=halal-documents
Certification is product-, formula- and scope-sensitive. A buyer should request the current document relevant to the selected product and destination.
Qualified projects can request company information, relevant certificates, product specifications, ingredient and allergen information, packing data and export documents.

## Important qualification notes

- Deesheng Food serves B2B buyers and does not sell individual retail units.
- Prices are not published because the exact product, pack, quantity, label route and raw-material conditions must be confirmed.
- Frozen-vegetable pricing is confirmed against product, cut, grade, pack and current raw-material market.
- Kimchi and frozen products need cold-chain planning; they should not be treated like ambient sauce cargo.
- Destination-market import and label compliance must be confirmed by the buyer and relevant local professionals or authorities.

## Detailed sauce specifications

Use the product URL for the full buyer answer, applications, eight purchasing FAQs and carton specifications. Availability and documentation must be checked for the selected formula and destination. Carton weights and dimensions are not shared between different carton configurations.

### Gochujang — Korean Chili Paste

URL: https://deesheng.food/product/gochujang/
Deesheng Food supplies Korean-style gochujang, a red pepper paste for importers, distributors, restaurant suppliers and private-label brands. The confirmed formats are 500 g tubs packed 20 per carton and a 14 kg foodservice carton. Both have a 12-month shelf life with ambient storage away from light. Choose the smaller format for retail distribution or the bulk format for commercial kitchens. Evaluate the selected formula for your desired balance of heat and sweetness. Share your destination, sales channel, selected pack and estimated quantity to request a matching sample, product documents and a quotation.

- 500 g tub × 20: 12 months; storage: Ambient; away from light; net 10 kg; gross 11.5 kg; carton 490 × 260 × 175 mm.
- 14 kg foodservice carton: 12 months; storage: Ambient; away from light; net 14 kg; gross 14.8 kg; carton 245 × 240 × 255 mm.

Carton dimensions are length × width × height. Confirm the selected retail pack or 14 kg inner-container construction and final label with your order.
